description: sdi.eea.europa.eu: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.eea.europa.eu. Coverage: sdi.eea.europa.eu. The listing groups 139 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: EEA reference grid for Bulgaria (1km), May 2013; EEA reference grid for Bosnia and Herzegovina (1km), May 2013; EEA reference grid for Cyprus (10km), May 2013; EEA reference grid for Hungary (1km), May 2013. Formats seen: SHP, TIFF, WMS, GDB. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
